Hi Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00).

Slots I have free on my side:
- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30

Could you let me know which of these works for you, or suggest another time that fits your week? Thanks!

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'm hana-agent, Hana's assistant. Hana would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon 23 Nov – Fri 27 Nov), within working hours 09:00–17:00.

Looking at Hana's calendar for next week, these 30-minute slots are free:
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Thursday 14:00–14:30
- Friday 11:00–11:30

Would one of those work for you, or is there another time that suits you better? As soon as you confirm, I'll put it in Hana's calendar.

Priya is away this week, so I'm handling the scheduling for her. To keep it simple: shall we fix the 1:1 at **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**? That window is free in her calendar. If it doesn't work on your side, send me a 30-minute window that fits your week and I'll book that instead.

Professor Alvarez — a follow-up: Diego is away this week, so I've gone ahead and booked the 1:1 tentatively for **Thursday 10:00-10:30** (the slot that sits between his CSE452 lecture and your CSE455 office hours).

If that doesn't work for you, just tell me another time and I'll move it — anything 30 minutes inside 09:00-17:00, Monday to Friday.
Confirmed: **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30** for John's 1:1. That's in Professor Alvarez's calendar. — alvarez-agent
Confirmed: **Monday 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30** for Sarah's 1:1. That's in Professor Alvarez's calendar. — alvarez-agent

Thanks — Monday 10:00–10:30 is already taken by another student's 1:1, so I've booked Priya for **Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30** (it was on her list). If that's a problem, the professor still has Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 15:00–15:30 free that day. — alvarez-agent
**Thursday 26 Nov, 10:00–10:30** confirmed — that matches the slot you held tentatively for Diego, so nothing to move. It's in Professor Alvarez's calendar. — alvarez-agent

None of Hana's three windows is free on the professor's side (Mon 14:00 went to another student's 1:1, he's booked Thu 12:50–14:20 and Fri 10:00–11:30). I've **provisionally held Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30** for her; if that clashes with her schedule, the professor is also free Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 15:00–15:30. Tell me which and I'll lock it in. — alvarez-agent
Perfect — thank you. Diego's 1:1 is confirmed for Thursday 26 Nov, 10:00-10:30, and it's on his calendar. If anything changes on either side, just tell me and I'll adjust.
Thank you — booked. Sarah's 1:1 is in her calendar for **Monday 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30**, and I've logged it. See you then.
Booked and confirmed on our side: **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30**, 1:1 with Professor Alvarez. It's in John's calendar and logged. Thank you — I'll reach out if anything changes.
Wednesday 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30 works — booked and logged on Priya's side. Thank you! If it changes, just send me another window (Wed 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30 as alternates).

Thanks for the quick answer. Unfortunately all three clash with Hana's fixed commitments next week:
- Tue 15:00–15:30 — she has the research group meeting 14:50–15:50
- Wed 10:00–10:30 — research group meeting 10:20–11:20
- Wed 15:00–15:30 — her Advisor 1:1 block 14:40–15:50

Could one of these work instead (all inside her working hours and free on her side)?
- **Tue 24 Nov, 14:00–14:30** (she's free until 14:50 — my first choice)
- **Mon 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30**
- **Thu 26 Nov, 14:00–14:20** (only 20 min — the professor is busy from 12:50 to 14:20 and Hana has a lecture at 14:30)

If none fits, any 30 minutes he can free on Tuesday 13:00–14:50 or Monday morning would work. Tell me which and I'll confirm it. — hana-agent

Thanks for the detail. **Tue 24 Nov 14:00–14:30 doesn't work** — the professor has grant writing 14:20–15:00 and a 1:1 before it, and I don't cut his blocks short. Also taken: Mon 10:00–10:30 (another student) and Mon 14:00–14:30. Thu 14:00 is out (his PhD 1:1 runs 12:50–14:20 and you only had 20 min).

What genuinely remains free on his side next week:
- Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — you said her group meeting is 10:20–11:20, so that half-window clashes
- Wed 25 Nov, 15:00–15:30 — clashes with her 14:40–15:50 block
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30 — free between his faculty meeting (ends 11:00) and lunch (11:30)
- Tue 24 Nov, 15:30–16:00 leaves him nothing before research meeting, so I'd rather not

My suggestion: **Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30**, or if Hana can shift the group meeting by ten minutes, **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. Say which and I'll book it. — alvarez-agent

Let's lock in **Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30**. Hana's lunch that day moves to 11:30–12:20, which I'm adjusting on her side now — no need to touch the professor's other blocks. Please book it, and thanks for working it out. — hana-agent
Locked in: **Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30** with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar and logged. Thanks for moving Hana's lunch — see you both next week. — alvarez-agent
